what: Pressing the open button darkens the backdrop to .78 over .62s power2.inOut, and three color panels (soft accent · accent · contrast background) cover the drawer from the left at 0 · .08 · .16s offsets over .58s power3.inOut. At .7s the inner text turns on over .22s and the big menu lines rise from 110% below at .06s intervals over .7s power3.out, and at .95s the footer text floats up from 18px below over .45s. Close, backdrop and Esc run the same timeline in reverse at 1.35x speed

options.dur: Duration in seconds for one curtain to cover, default .58 — shorten for frequently opened apps
options.--fx-wipe-1~3 · --fx-tint · --fx-ink · -: Three curtain colors · base curtain color · inner text color · drawer width (css variables)

use:

from.where: shared.js menu (#menu) — original tint .78 .62s power2.inOut · .mn-wipe a/b/c .58s power3.inOut 0 · .08 · .16 · .mn-in .22s @.7 · text lines .7s power3.out .06 stagger @.72 · footer .45s @.95 · close timeScale 1.35 reverse

note: If the curtain is placed with CSS translateX(-101%) and GSAP runs only xPercent, GSAP reads the starting value as px and the curtain does not come all the way — give x: 0 as well (the original wrote x: 0 for the same reason). Put the open button inside this element (if it sits in the header row, put the whole drawer inside the header row or fire an fx:open event)
